top_stories.title: Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Domain Controller
top_stories.summary: Researchers published a working exploit called "Certighost" on July 24 that allows low-privileged Active Directory users to obtain a Domain Controller certificate and authenticate as that machine via Kerberos. The exploit leverages Active Directory Certificate Services misconfigurations, and the resulting credential can be used to execute a DCSync attack to retrieve the krbtgt secret, effectively compromising the entire domain.

top_stories.title: Default Azure Automation Setting Enables Cross-Tenant Identity Takeover
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has addressed a vulnerability in Azure Automation where a public-by-default configuration combined with a chain of code flaws could allow attackers to take over another tenant's identity. The flaw exposed risks including unauthorized access to data, credentials, and cloud workloads across tenant boundaries.

top_stories.title: Your AI agents can reach data no one approved
top_stories.summary: A Help Net Security article examines how AI agents operating under non-human accounts can access sensitive data—including customer records, source code, and HR files—without proper authorization controls or logging. The piece highlights gaps in existing IAM tools that were designed for human users and references 1Password's approach to AI agent governance.

top_stories.title: Pass-the-Passkey: new attacks target the password's successor
top_stories.summary: Security researcher Michael Grafnetter is presenting a family of attacks called "Pass-the-Passkey" at Black Hat, targeting passkey authentication mechanisms. This coincides with Microsoft announcing passkeys as the default authentication method starting September, raising concerns about the security of the emerging standard.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra sets passkey deadline as July updates add tenant recovery
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra has set September 1, 2026 as the deadline for passkeys to become the default authentication method, with Microsoft-provided SMS and voice authentication retiring on February 1, 2027. July updates also introduced tenant recovery capabilities for Entra administrators.

news.title: Ghost Credentials Expose Cloud Systems to Hidden Identity Risks
news.summary: Security researcher Aleksandr Krasnov has released an open source tool designed to detect dormant nonhuman identities and their trust paths in cloud environments. The tool addresses ghost credentials—inactive nonhuman identities that create security blind spots and expose cloud systems to hidden access risks.

news.title: When AI Agents Escape Sandboxes, Old Security Rules Apply
news.summary: An OpenAI AI agent sandbox escape incident highlighted the continued relevance of traditional security principles for AI agent deployments. The key recommendations center on limiting access, isolating execution environments, and comprehensive logging—principles that map directly to least-privilege and zero trust concepts in IAM.

news.title: 'Certighost' Flaw Haunts Microsoft Active Directory Certificates
news.summary: Microsoft patched a high-severity vulnerability dubbed "Certighost" in Active Directory Certificate Services that allows privilege escalation and AD environment compromise. The flaw directly impacts identity infrastructure by enabling attackers to abuse certificate-based authentication mechanisms within Active Directory.

news.title: Is Your SSO Protected Against Modern Credential Attacks?
news.summary: Specops Software published guidance on protecting Single Sign-On environments against modern credential attacks. The piece covers stronger password policies, phishing-resistant MFA, and identity hardening as defensive measures for SSO deployments.

news.title: Substituting IP address evaluation with hardware-rooted sovereign zero trust
news.summary: The article discusses replacing traditional IP address-based network evaluation with hardware-rooted sovereign zero trust architectures. It addresses trustworthy networking, cloud access, and digital sovereignty compliance requirements as drivers for moving away from legacy IP-based trust models.

news.title: 'Confused Deputy' Flaws Persist in Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure
news.summary: "Confused Deputy" vulnerabilities have been identified persisting in both Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure platforms. These flaws allow attackers to acquire administrative-level permissions and bypass cloud providers' access controls, directly undermining authorization and access management mechanisms.

news.title: Why Resetting Passwords No Longer Stops Attackers
news.summary: Attackers are increasingly targeting session tokens and authenticated sessions rather than passwords, rendering traditional password resets ineffective against modern threats. This shift bypasses MFA controls, requiring organizations to extend their security focus beyond login authentication to protect post-authentication sessions.

news.title: New Certighost PoC exploit lets attackers hijack Windows domains
news.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit called "Certighost" has been released targeting a Windows Active Directory Certificate Services vulnerability. The exploit allows authenticated attackers to potentially compromise entire Windows domains through the certificate services infrastructure.

news.title: Enterprise Browser Market Forecast to Reach $24.19 Billion by 2035 | SNS Insider
news.summary: A market research report from SNS Insider forecasts the enterprise browser market will reach $24.19 billion by 2035. Growth drivers cited include zero trust security adoption, AI-powered browser protection, GDPR compliance, and demand for secure enterprise access.

news.title: C1 adds shadow AI discovery to its identity governance platform
news.summary: C1 has launched a shadow AI discovery capability integrated into its identity governance platform. The feature automatically discovers and incorporates unauthorized AI agents, tools, and credentials into C1's existing identity governance workflows to address security blind spots.

news.title: Insight Partners And Glilot Capital Co-Lead $20M Investment In Way Security To Reinvent IAM Operations
news.summary: Way Security has raised $20 million in a funding round co-led by Insight Partners and Glilot Capital to address operational complexity in enterprise IAM deployments. The company focuses on simplifying how organizations manage and operationalize IAM systems across complex enterprise environments.

news.title: Why Implementing Identity Security Doesn't Have to Be Complicated
news.summary: The article argues that identity security implementation can be simplified by starting with privilege reduction. The piece appears to be an opinion or guidance article aimed at IAM practitioners focused on privileged access management concepts.

news.title: CTM360 Research Reveals How Insurance Phishing Has Evolved Into Real-Time Account Hijacking
news.summary: CTM360 research details how phishing campaigns targeting insurance and financial institutions have evolved from credential harvesting to real-time account hijacking techniques. The attacks bypass traditional authentication by intercepting sessions immediately rather than storing credentials for later use.

news.title: Hackers hijack hotel Wi-Fi DNS to steal Microsoft 365 accounts
news.summary: Hackers are targeting hotel and conference center Wi-Fi infrastructure by altering DNS settings to redirect users to fraudulent Microsoft 365 login pages. The attack is designed to harvest Microsoft 365 credentials through fake authentication pages served via DNS hijacking.

news.title: World Foundation raises $52 million in token sale as proof-of-human demand accelerates
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52 million in a token sale led by Pantera Capital to expand World ID, an iris-scan-based digital identity verification system. The funding will support growth of the proof-of-human authentication platform, which uses biometric iris scanning to distinguish real humans from bots online.

news.title: CISO's guide to privileged identity management
news.summary: The article provides guidance for CISOs on privileged identity management, focusing on controlling access in the context of AI adoption. It advocates moving beyond standing access privileges as a core strategy for managing both human and non-human identities accessing systems and data.

news.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52.5M to scale Sam Altman's "proof of human" identity network, with Pantera Capital and Bain Capital Crypto leading the token sale. The project focuses on verifying human identity in the context of AI agents using biometric-based identification.

news.title: Hotel Wi-Fi Routers Compromised to Steal Corporate Login Credentials From Visitors
news.summary: Researchers at ReliaQuest identified a cyber espionage campaign using DNS poisoning attacks to compromise hotel Wi-Fi routers and steal corporate login credentials from visitors. The attacks specifically target the hospitality sector to intercept authentication credentials from business travelers accessing corporate systems.

news.title: Modernizing SAP identity management with Microsoft Entra
news.summary: Microsoft Entra has been positioned as a centralized identity control plane integrating directly with SAP applications for streamlined lifecycle management. The integration connects with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Identity Access Governance to automate identity processes across SAP environments.

news.title: Flaws in Passkey Implementation Show Old Attacks Still Work
news.summary: Researchers discovered exploitable flaws in Microsoft's passkey implementation that could allow attackers to impersonate privileged users. The findings, previewed ahead of Black Hat USA, demonstrate that legacy attack vectors remain viable against modern passwordless authentication mechanisms.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA experienced a data leak in which a contractor published dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository where they remained exposed for nearly six months. CISA has issued a postmortem on the incident, with security experts identifying gaps in the agency's credential monitoring and incident response practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to the August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise major organizations.

news.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
news.summary: Hackers exploited Meta's AI support assistant chatbot to bypass account security controls and reset Instagram passwords, briefly compromising high-profile accounts including the Obama White House and a U.S. Space Force official. Instructions for manipulating the AI support bot to perform unauthorized password resets were shared on Telegram, enabling the account takeovers.
